DFMA Review · S6 turning · mock-up of a screen change · 8 Nov 2026

Lathe plan in the Machine plan panel

S6 fills the Machine plan panel for parts reviewed for Turning: the machine ("lathe" or "lathe with live tooling"), the turning axis, the tool loads, and one setup on the lathe with its tools. As D-023 approved, the setup is selectable and lights every face its tools cut, and the Passed list covers turned features too. The pictures are screenshots of the built screen on the S6 test parts.

Your call

Approve, Change (say what), or Rethink.

Try it yourself in the demo: pick slender_shaft.step with Turning, then with Milling.
